figurative_meaning_bn: যার শত্রু নাই; যার শত্রু জন্মায়নি; যে শত্রুতা করে না
figurative_meaning_en: One who has no enemies; one whose enemy has not been born; one who does not make enemies
similar_in_english: Without an enemy in the world
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি জীবনে কখনো শত্রুতা করেননি, তাই অজাতশত্রু হিসেবে পরিচিত।
এই নিরীহ মানুষটিকে দেখে মনে হয় অজাতশত্রু।
example_sentences_in_english: He never makes enemies in life, so he is known as a man without enemies.
Looking at this innocent person, one feels he is without an enemy in the world.
history: Refers to Yudhishthira from the Mahabharata epic, who was called Ajatashatru for his dharma (righteousness) and lack of personal enemies despite the epic's conflicts.
note: Derived from Sanskrit roots, commonly used in Bengali literature to denote exemplary moral character.
